ModuleName: 2 - Project Scoping and App Platform Selection
CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's topics and subtopics, covering project scoping, target platform categories, and platform-specific characteristics for Android, iOS, and others, used as a navigational reference for the module's content.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: An HTML page listing the topics covered in Module 2, focusing on defining project scope in HCI design and selecting an app platform; learners use it as a navigational overview to understand what the module will cover before diving into individual lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Project_Scoping_and_generated.pptx
Artifacts.Description: A slide deck covering the full module on project scoping and app platform selection, introducing concepts such as defining scope, platform overviews, and tool selection; used by instructors as a lecture presentation or by learners as a study reference.

Artifacts.Name: Defining Project Scope in HCI Design
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to establish project scope in HCI design by defining goals, boundaries, constraints, and target users before any design work begins; used by learners to understand why and how scope shapes all subsequent design decisions.

Artifacts.Name: Overview of Target Application Platforms
Artifacts.Description: A reading surveying the four major application platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, and web), explaining how platform choice fundamentally influences design and development decisions; used by learners to orient themselves to the platform landscape before diving into platform-specific details.

Artifacts.Name: Android Platform: Characteristics and Constraints
Artifacts.Description: A reading detailing Android's design characteristics, constraints, device fragmentation, and UI conventions that designers and developers must account for; used by learners to understand the unique challenges and considerations when targeting the Android platform.

Artifacts.Name: iOS Platform: Characteristics and Constraints
Artifacts.Description: A reading detailing iOS's tightly controlled hardware-software ecosystem, Apple's design conventions, App Store constraints, and expectations designers must meet; used by learners to understand the specific requirements and conventions governing iOS app design.

Artifacts.Name: Windows Platform: Characteristics and Constraints
Artifacts.Description: A reading covering Windows as a desktop platform, including its dominant installed base, UI conventions, input models, and constraints relevant to software designers and developers; used by learners to understand what targeting Windows entails for HCI design.

Artifacts.Name: Web Platform: Characteristics and Constraints
Artifacts.Description: A reading explaining the web as an application platform, covering browser-based delivery, cross-platform reach, accessibility considerations, and the technical and design constraints unique to web applications; used by learners to understand web-specific HCI design challenges.

Artifacts.Name: Platform Selection: Criteria and Decision-Making
Artifacts.Description: A reading presenting the criteria and decision-making framework for selecting an application platform, covering factors such as audience, technical feasibility, cost, and team capability; used by learners to evaluate and justify platform choices in their own projects.

Artifacts.Name: Design and Development Tools by Platform
Artifacts.Description: A reading cataloguing the wireframing, prototyping, visual design, coding, and debugging tools available for each major platform, explaining how toolchain choices affect workflow and platform alignment; used by learners to identify appropriate tools for their chosen platform.

Artifacts.Name: Design and Development Tools by Platform
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate reading identical to artifact 9, cataloguing design and development tools by platform including wireframing, prototyping, and coding tools; used by learners to identify and compare appropriate toolchains for their target platform.

Artifacts.Name: Assignment 1.1: Project Scope Definition and Formal Project Description
Artifacts.Description: A detailed markdown assignment sheet guiding student groups through creating a formal project scope document that defines measurable goals, target users, platform justification, and design constraints, serving as the first installment of a semester-long group project series.

Artifacts.Name: Group Project Assignment 1: Project Scoping and Platform Selection
Artifacts.Description: An HTML assignment brief directing student teams to collaboratively define their app project scope and select a target platform, outlining submission requirements, estimated effort, and group coordination expectations as the first entry in the ongoing group project series.
